science.qualification: Color of a black body at the dayside brightness temperature 2,750 K measured in secondary eclipse in the Kepler, Ks, 3.6 µm and 4.5 µm bands together (Shporer et al. 2014, the temperature of a black body showing the same occultation depths in all four bands), uniform over the disc and lit by its star so the day side faces it. The planet is unresolved: no map is implied, and reflected starlight is not included.

metadata.limbMeaning: The adopted source-radius opaque-sphere silhouette and prepared phase lighting define the limb; no atmospheric rim is inferred.
